description: This file implements a user registration API endpoint for a Django-based backend, including a serializer for validating and creating users, and a view function to handle registration requests, generate JWT tokens, and return user profile data.

classes.name: RegisterSerializer
classes.description: Serializer class for validating and creating a new user, including password validation and optional role assignment.

methods.name: register
methods.description: API view function that handles user registration, validates input, creates user, and returns user profile and JWT tokens if auto_login is enabled.
